note: 给玩家开放「方块速查手册」的 NPC,会问玩家能挖动的最硬方块是什么。

messages.raw: §fY'know now that we are getting deeper and deeper a lot of these blocks are getting harder to mine!
messages.text: Y'know now that we are getting deeper and deeper a lot of these blocks are getting harder to mine!
messages.zh: 你有没有发现,越往深处走,这些方块就越难挖!

messages.raw: §fLuckily I have a §ehandy guide§f right here for you!
messages.text: Luckily I have a handy guide right here for you!

segments.zh: 幸好我这儿正好有一本

messages.raw: §fHey you! Can you bring me the hardest block you can mine?
messages.text: Hey you! Can you bring me the hardest block you can mine?
messages.zh: 喂,那边的! 你能把你挖得动的最硬的方块带给我看看吗?

messages.raw: §fCactus? I'm sure you could do better, but I'll take it for now.
messages.text: Cactus? I'm sure you could do better, but I'll take it for now.
messages.zh: 仙人掌?我相信你还能挖到更硬的,不过眼下就先收下吧。

messages.raw: §fJust as I thought...I am talking to a softie!
messages.text: Just as I thought...I am talking to a softie!
messages.zh: 果然不出我所料……我这是在跟个软脚虾说话啊!
